title: clutia richardiana var. pubescens
intro: Clutia richardiana var. pubescens, commonly known as a shrub or small tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in its leaves, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Clutia richardiana var. pubescens include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
